mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in residential construction permits above 1.7 million units per month signals strong household demand and rising inflationary expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered periods, or the average 20d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a flat or rising FEDFUNDS rate, indicates persistent inflation that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, increasing equity risk premiums and reducing forward S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce negative 60d SPX returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient in a rolling regression is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production below 98.0 index points signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d SPX returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 600 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, signals strong aggregate demand that triggers inflation fears and forces the Fed to delay rate cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict negative 20d SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term's predictive power is not significant (p > 0.05) in a rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in payroll employment above 200,000 jobs per month, especially when combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a labor market overheating that increases inflation expectations and leads to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized growth, especially when accompanied by rising residential construction, signals strong economic momentum that increases inflationary pressures and leads to tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to predict negative 60d SPX returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in a rolling regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained period of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) combined with rising CPIAUCSL above 2.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that fails to contain inflation, leading to market expectations of future rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 2-year rolling window.
